ui-test-agent 1.0.0

- Initial release enabling automated UI testing of web pages with a full "record-then-report" workflow.
- Supports agent-browser CLI step execution, required per-step screenshots, and session recording.
- Automatically generates replayable test scripts (shell/JSON) and a standalone HTML test report with embedded screenshots.
- Workflow strictly documents all actions, errors, and test evidence, ensuring thorough reporting and reproducibility.
- Recommended triggers include UI自动化测试, browser automation test, record and replay, test report, 测试报告, agent-browser测试.
